scope: Primary regular/conforming terrain integrates the existing shared sky/cloud field through the existing rough dielectric GGX material. Reflection-only quadrature and reflected-cloud transport budgets; no terrain law, topology, height, material page, simulation, render target or pass change. A corrected shadow control is included to separate shadowing from the new reflection term. Not whole-frame visual acceptance.

contract.source: render-wgpu/src/environment.wgsl::env_specular_from; shared single-scattering sky plus existing reflected-cloud extinction/in-scatter at the surface origin.
contract.brdf: GGX distribution, Schlick-Smith masking and Schlick Fresnel with F0=0.04, matching the existing rcbt-core direct dielectric kernel. Visible-normal sampling: Heitz, JCGT 7(4), 2018, with exact G1 PDF and weight correction to Schlick-Smith. Below-surface samples contribute zero and stay in the denominator.
contract.quadrature: Deterministic Hammersley, no frame-random history. Clear sky 4/8/16 directions at low/medium/high surface_quality. With reflected clouds: 1/2/4 directions and 1/2/4 view steps, capped by the producer, at most one sun-depth step (zero if producer disables sun-depth integration).
contract.cloud_transport: Each hollow-shell segment stores the physical source at its midpoint; Beer-Lambert is solved analytically after density quadrature. Full nested primary march per direction is not used. Density, phase, extinction, scattering and self-shadow laws are unchanged.
contract.disable: renderer.specular_reflections=false compiles the terrain hook to zero and omits land-only sky bindings. Other sky/cloud/ocean consumers are independent. No published atmosphere/aurora sky yields zero added reflection, not invented ambient.
contract.cost_scope: render.scene_classify_and_raster; the isolated fixture is a regular black sphere/material/sky with no direct light, shadows or clouds, and is not whole-client cost.

grazing_terrain_environment_remains_bounded: independent solid-angle D*G*F oracle at N.V=0.7/0.2, 8/255 envelope; maximum observed deviation 7/255.

rough_terrain_blurs_environment_and_tracks_publication_without_material_uploads: red/blue directional fields; rough material broadens reflection; same-size field writes reach terrain without material reupload.

terrain_reflected_cloud_budget_preserves_transport: independent smooth spherical deck, isotropic blue source and red incident sky; actual [60,0,15] versus reference [63,0,15] on both grids, tolerance 8.
terrain_environment_gpu_cost: counterbalanced disabled/Low/Medium/High and reverse order, 32 measured samples each, actual GPU timestamps.

shadow_control.purpose: Correct the invalid earlier no-shadow attempt, which accidentally disabled the atmosphere as well.
shadow_control.config: atmosphere.enabled=true, shadows.enabled=false, specular_reflections=true, surface_quality=high, site 1, 32 frames, 1280x720.
shadow_control.conclusion: The corrected control isolates shadowing: atmosphere publication is identical, while only 3.21% of pixels change by more than 4/255. The visible ridge speckles and conforming gaps are present with and without shadows and are not shadow darkening.

dark_pixel_scan.note: Superseded interpretation: these are not background gaps. A constant-red fragment output removed them and the black pixels had zero final radiance with non-zero albedo and illuminance, so they were shaded fragments whose grazing environment integral was empty. The horizon guard in docs/artifacts/native-terrain-horizon-guard-2026-10-20.json removes them; the constant [31,31,33] colour is not a clear-colour leak.

rejected_cost_evidence.implementation: First reflection attempt nested the full primary cloud march under every sky sample.
rejected_cost_evidence.development_capture: 1280x720 COAST GPU median about 1877 ms versus 38 ms with specular disabled.
rejected_cost_evidence.status: Development measurement; the rejected code path is no longer in the tree and its raw log was not retained, so this figure is not independently re-runnable from this artifact. It motivated the cheaper reflected-cloud budget and is not an optimization win.

limitations: Material-normal detail, close-up relief/erosion convergence, vegetation/canopy, finite aerial perspective and primary scene-object terrain/ocean RT reflections remain incomplete.

Regular terrain still shows thin dark ridge rims with specular enabled; these are reflected sky at grazing incidence (a specular-off control has minimum channel sum 278), not holes. They remain a visual-quality/aliasing issue and are not accepted.
Captured frame medians include the whole scene (sky, clouds, HDR display, streaming), not environment-only cost. The isolated cost fixture excludes shadows/direct light/clouds.
The no-shadow control covers site 1 only. Numerical oracles are fixture-specific, not general HDR/cloud transport or grazing material-normal error guarantees.
No blind subjective preference, cross-platform, motion-stability or whole-frame visual parity follows. The user goal of planet-wide Satisfactory-level detail is not met by this stage.

correction.what: The dark silhouette pixels recorded here were initially called background geometry gaps. They were actually terrain fragments with zero grazing environment reflection; the horizon guard removes them.
